lyrics.ja: あの日　見た空　茜色の空を
lyrics.romaji: Ano Hi Mita Sora Akane Iro no Sora wo
lyrics.en: The sky we saw that day—that crimson sky
lyrics.zh: 那一天所見的天空，茜紅色的天空

lyrics.ja: ねえ　君は憶えていますか？
lyrics.romaji: Nee Kimi ha Oboete Imasu ka?
lyrics.en: Hey, do you remember it?

lyrics.ja: 約束契り　初夏の風が包む
lyrics.romaji: Yakusoku Chigiri Shoka no Kaze ga Tsutsumu
lyrics.en: We exchanged promises, wrapped in the early summer wind
lyrics.zh: 許下約定，初夏的風輕拂包圍

lyrics.ja: 二人寄り添った
lyrics.romaji: Futari Yorisotta
lyrics.en: The two of us drew close

lyrics.ja: 無理な　笑顔の裏
lyrics.romaji: Muri na Egao no Ura
lyrics.en: Behind a forced smile

lyrics.ja: 伸びた影を匿う
lyrics.romaji: Nobita Kage wo Kakumau
lyrics.en: I hide my stretching shadow

lyrics.ja: だから　気付かぬふり　再生を選ぶ
lyrics.romaji: Dakara Kizukanu Furi Saisei wo Erabu
lyrics.en: So I pretend not to notice and choose to replay
lyrics.zh: 所以裝作沒察覺，選擇了重播

lyrics.ja: テーブルの上の　震えない知らせ
lyrics.romaji: Teeburu no Ue no Furuenai Shirase
lyrics.en: A steady notification on the table

lyrics.ja: 待ち続けて
lyrics.romaji: Machi Tsuzukete
lyrics.en: I kept waiting

lyrics.ja: 空白の夜も
lyrics.romaji: Kuuhaku no Yoru mo
lyrics.en: Even the blank nights

lyrics.ja: 来るはずのない朝も
lyrics.romaji: Kuru Hazu no Nai Asa mo
lyrics.en: And the mornings that were never meant to come
lyrics.zh: 不可能到來的早晨也好

lyrics.ja: 全部分かってたんだ
lyrics.romaji: Zenbu Wakatteta n Da
lyrics.en: I understood it all

lyrics.ja: あの日　見た空　茜色の空を
lyrics.romaji: Ano Hi Mita Sora Akane Iro no Sora wo
lyrics.en: The sky we saw that day—that crimson sky
lyrics.zh: 那一天所見的天空，茜紅色的天空

lyrics.ja: ねえ　君は忘れたのでしょう？
lyrics.romaji: Nee Kimi ha Wasureta no Deshou?
lyrics.en: Hey, you've forgotten it, haven't you?

lyrics.ja: 約束　千切り　初夏の風を消えた
lyrics.romaji: Yakusoku Chigiri Shoka no Kaze wo Kieta
lyrics.en: Promises torn to pieces—the early summer wind disappeared
lyrics.zh: 約定被撕碎，初夏的風已消逝

lyrics.ja: 二人　戻れない
lyrics.romaji: Futari Modorenai
lyrics.en: The two of us can't go back

lyrics.ja: 音も色も温度も半分になった この部屋
lyrics.romaji: Oto mo Iro mo Ondo mo Hanbun ni Natta Kono Heya
lyrics.en: In this room where sound, color, and warmth have all halved
lyrics.zh: 聲音、色彩、溫度都只剩下一半的這個房間

lyrics.ja: 今日も　散らかしては
lyrics.romaji: Kyou mo Chirakashite ha
lyrics.en: Today again, I make a mess

lyrics.ja: 揺れ　疲れ　眠る
lyrics.romaji: Yure Tsukare Nemuru
lyrics.en: Wavering, tired, I sleep

lyrics.ja: 「上手に騙してね　嘘は嫌いで好き」　君の言葉
lyrics.romaji: 「Jouzu ni Damashite ne Uso ha Kirai de Suki」 Kimi no Kotoba
lyrics.en: "Deceive me well — I hate lies, but I love them," your words
lyrics.zh: 「好好地騙我吧，我討厭謊言卻又喜歡」你的話語

lyrics.ja: 今頃になって　気持ちは痛いほど
lyrics.romaji: Imagoro ni Natte Kimochi ha Itai Hodo
lyrics.en: Only now do these feelings ache
lyrics.zh: 到了現在，心情痛徹心扉

lyrics.ja: だから　僕ら　さよなら
lyrics.romaji: Dakara Bokura Sayonara
lyrics.en: So we said goodbye

lyrics.ja: いつかまたねと　手を振り合ったけど
lyrics.romaji: Itsuka Mata ne to Te wo Furiattta kedo
lyrics.en: We waved at each other, saying "See you someday"

lyrics.ja: もう　逢うことはないでしょう
lyrics.romaji: Mou Au Koto ha Nai Deshou
lyrics.en: But we'll probably never meet again
lyrics.zh: 但大概不會再見面了吧

lyrics.ja: 最後の嘘は　優しい嘘でした
lyrics.romaji: Saigo no Uso ha Yasashii Uso Deshita
lyrics.en: The last lie was a kind lie
lyrics.zh: 最後的謊言，是溫柔的謊言

lyrics.ja: 忘れない
lyrics.romaji: Wasurenai
lyrics.en: I won't forget

lyrics.ja: あの日　見た空　茜色の空を
lyrics.romaji: Ano Hi Mita Sora Akane Iro no Sora wo
lyrics.en: The sky we saw that day—that crimson sky
lyrics.zh: 那一天所見的天空，茜紅色的天空

lyrics.ja: ねえ　いつか思い出すでしょう？
lyrics.romaji: Nee Itsuka Omoidasu Deshou?
lyrics.en: Hey, someday you'll remember, won't you?
lyrics.zh: 吶，總有一天會想起來吧？

lyrics.ja: 果（は）たせなかった　約束を抱いて
lyrics.romaji: Hatasenakatta Yakusoku wo Idaite
lyrics.en: Holding onto the promise we couldn't keep
lyrics.zh: 懷抱著未能實現的約定

lyrics.ja: 二人　歩き出す
lyrics.romaji: Futari Arukidasu
lyrics.en: The two of us start walking
